rules.statement: A surety is entitled to a reduction in liability when the creditor releases part of the security, but is not absolutely discharged from all obligations.
rules.supporting_quote: "In the case, however, of the exceptio cedendarum actionum it appears to be clear that the law, as laid down by Pothier and by the American jurists, limits the discharge of the surety to the loss that can be shown to have accrued to him from the creditor's misfeasance."
